name: dart daA1440-220um

sources.title: daA1440-220um | Basler Product Documentation
sources.covers: sensor, shutter, resolution, pixel size, sensor format, frame rate, interface, mounts, power, mass, housing size

note: A board-level / small-housing USB 3.0 machine-vision camera sold without a lens (S-mount, CS-mount or bare board), so no FOV, f-number or focus is stated: the imager has no FOV and the library uses its labelled default until the user enters the chosen lens (or a calibration). Sensor Sony IMX273LLR-C, mono, global shutter, 3.45 um pixels, 1/2.9". Resolution: 1456 x 1088 full, 1440 x 1080 default. Frame rate 98.9 fps with default settings; 227.7 fps with default settings, minimum exposure time and the Device Link Throughput Limit disabled. Pixel formats are on a separate Basler page (not read), so the stream format is null. Power "~2 W (typical) @ 5 VDC". Mass "<15 g" for the S-mount and CS-mount versions (a bound, so mass_g is null; bare board <5 g). size_mm is the S-/CS-mount housing, 20 x 29 x 29 mm (L x W x H), with L along the optical axis.
interface: USB 3.0 (SuperSpeed, nominal max. 5 Gbit/s); USB3 Vision
